about: A relative or authorised person applies for a death certificate, with optional Ministry of Foreign Affairs certification.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: A relative of the deceased or an authorised person
documents: Deceased's Emirates ID, passport and residence visa
Power of attorney or authorisation letter, if applying for someone else
fees: AED 300 Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation
AED 50 per copy from the third copy onward
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
